This morning coming across 30th street I got stuck behind two fire trucks. They had their sirens blaring but couldn't get anywhere. They were as stuck as I was.

Coming down Broadway past Union Square I pulled up behind another citibiker with a GoPro on his helmet. His shirt was from developers.nytimes.com, so I wondered if maybe he was collecting video for a feature. So I asked him "What's up with the GoPro?"

His response: "So when a taxi runs over my a\*\*, my wife will get a nice settlement."

Call it an insurance policy, I guess.
